pred_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "case" WHERE severity = 1;
SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS case_count FROM "case" GROUP BY category ORDER BY category;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS failed_drives FROM telemetry_drive_summary WHERE failed = 1   AND failure_date >= (SELECT max(failure_date) FROM telemetry_drive_summary) - interval '3 months';
SELECT i.on_hand FROM inventory i JOIN part p ON i.part_id = p.part_id WHERE p.part_number = 'PRT-0004'   AND i.depot_id = 'DEPOT-EMEA';
SELECT region, COUNT(*) AS technician_count FROM technician GROUP BY region;
SELECT model, failure_count FROM drive_model ORDER BY failure_count DESC LIMIT 5;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dispatch WHERE outcome = 'parts_not_available';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM site WHERE region = 'APJ';
SELECT p.family AS product_family, COUNT(r.runbook_id) AS runbook_count FROM product p JOIN runbook r ON r.product_family = p.family GROUP BY p.family ORDER BY p.family;
SELECT depot_id, part_id FROM inventory WHERE on_hand < reorder_point;

SELECT s.region, COUNT(c.case_id) AS case_count FROM "case" c JOIN installed_asset ia ON c.asset_id = ia.asset_id JOIN site s ON ia.site_id = s.site_id WHERE c.opened_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.region ORDER BY s.region;

SELECT p.family AS product_family,        COUNT(d.dispatch_id) AS dispatch_count FROM dispatch d JOIN "case" c ON d.case_id = c.case_id JOIN installed_asset ia ON c.asset_id = ia.asset_id JOIN product p ON ia.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.family ORDER BY p.family;
SELECT p.part_number FROM dispatch_part dp JOIN part p ON dp.part_id = p.part_id GROUP BY p.part_number ORDER BY SUM(dp.quantity) DESC LIMIT 5;

WITH case_visits AS (     SELECT         c.case_id,         c.category,         COUNT(d.dispatch_id) AS visit_count     FROM "case" c     JOIN dispatch d ON d.case_id = c.case_id     GROUP BY c.case_id, c.category ) SELECT     category,     AVG(visit_count) AS average_visits_per_case FROM case_visits GROUP BY category ORDER BY category;
SELECT p.family,        COUNT(ia.asset_id) AS asset_count FROM installed_asset ia JOIN product p ON ia.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.family ORDER BY p.family;
SELECT t.name AS technician_name, COUNT(d.dispatch_id) AS dispatch_count FROM dispatch d JOIN technician t ON d.technician_id = t.technician_id GROUP BY t.name ORDER BY dispatch_count DESC LIMIT 5;
SELECT p.part_number, s.name AS supplier_name FROM part p JOIN part_supplier ps ON p.part_id = ps.part_id JOIN supplier s ON ps.supplier_id = s.supplier_id WHERE ps.preferred = true;

SELECT c.severity,        COUNT(*) AS case_count FROM "case" c JOIN installed_asset ia ON c.asset_id = ia.asset_id JOIN product p ON ia.product_id = p.product_id WHERE p.family = 'Storage Array' GROUP BY c.severity ORDER BY c.severity;

SELECT t.region AS technician_region,        SUM(dp.quantity) AS total_quantity FROM dispatch_part dp JOIN part p ON dp.part_id = p.part_id JOIN dispatch d ON dp.dispatch_id = d.dispatch_id JOIN technician t ON d.technician_id = t.technician_id WHERE p.category = 'drive' GROUP BY t.region ORDER BY t.region;
SELECT datacenter,        COUNT(*) AS drives_observed,        SUM(failed) AS drives_failed FROM telemetry_drive_summary GROUP BY datacenter;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS case_count FROM "case" WHERE opened_at::date >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) - interval '1 month'   AND opened_at::date < date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE);

WITH case_dispatch AS (     SELECT         c.case_id,         c.asset_id,         c.opened_at::timestamp AS opened_ts,         MIN(d.scheduled_at) AS first_dispatch_ts     FROM "case" c     JOIN dispatch d ON d.case_id = c.case_id     GROUP BY c.case_id, c.asset_id, c.opened_at ), case_site AS (     SELECT         cd.case_id,         cd.opened_ts,         cd.first_dispatch_ts,         s.region     FROM case_dispatch cd     JOIN installed_asset ia ON ia.asset_id = cd.asset_id     JOIN site s ON s.site_id = ia.site_id ) SELECT     cs.region,     AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (cs.first_dispatch_ts - cs.opened_ts)) / 3600.0) AS mean_hours_to_first_dispatch FROM case_site cs GROUP BY cs.region ORDER BY cs.region;

WITH dispatch_counts AS (     SELECT         p.family,         COUNT(*) AS total_dispatches,         SUM(CASE WHEN d.visit_number > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS repeat_dispatches     FROM dispatch d     JOIN "case" c ON d.case_id = c.case_id     JOIN installed_asset ia ON c.asset_id = ia.asset_id     JOIN product p ON ia.product_id = p.product_id     GROUP BY p.family ) SELECT     family AS product_family,     CASE WHEN total_dispatches = 0 THEN NULL ELSE repeat_dispatches::double precision / total_dispatches END AS repeat_dispatch_rate FROM dispatch_counts ORDER BY family;

WITH max_dt AS (     SELECT max(opened_at::date) AS max_opened FROM "case" ), bounds AS (     SELECT         (date_trunc('quarter', max_opened) - interval '3 months')::date AS start_dt,         date_trunc('quarter', max_opened)::date AS end_dt     FROM max_dt ) SELECT COUNT(*) AS deflectable_cases_last_quarter FROM "case" c JOIN bounds b ON 1 = 1 WHERE c.category = 'Deflectable'   AND c.opened_at::date >= b.start_dt   AND c.opened_at::date < b.end_dt;
SELECT site_id, site_name, expected_failures_30d FROM fleet_risk_sites ORDER BY expected_failures_30d DESC LIMIT 5;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pod_id) FROM telemetry_drive_summary WHERE failed = 1;

SELECT   COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE warranty_end IS NOT NULL AND warranty_end >= CURRENT_DATE) AS in_warranty,   COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE warranty_end IS NOT NULL AND warranty_end < CURRENT_DATE) AS out_of_warranty,   COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE warranty_end IS NULL) AS unknown_warranty FROM installed_asset;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS service_failures FROM "case" c JOIN installed_asset ia ON c.asset_id = ia.asset_id WHERE NOT EXISTS (     SELECT 1     FROM telemetry_drive_summary tds     WHERE tds.serial_number = ia.serial_number       AND (tds.failed = 1 OR tds.failure_date IS NOT NULL) );
SELECT AVG(ps.lead_time_days) AS average_lead_time_days FROM part p JOIN part_supplier ps ON p.part_id = ps.part_id WHERE p.category = 'drive';

WITH worst_site AS (   SELECT site_id   FROM fleet_risk_sites   ORDER BY expected_failures_30d DESC NULLS LAST   LIMIT 1 ) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ia.asset_id) AS open_case_asset_count FROM installed_asset ia JOIN worst_site ws ON ia.site_id = ws.site_id JOIN "case" c ON c.asset_id = ia.asset_id WHERE (c.closed_at IS NULL OR c.closed_at = '');
